# Adaptify

> Adaptify LLC builds AI-powered infrastructure for roofing companies: websites, CRMs and lead automations. Every build is deployed to the client's own Cloudflare account and fully owned by them, never a rented SaaS tool.

## Services
- AI Powered Websites: fast, SEO- and AI-search-optimized static sites built only for roofing companies, free hosting for life, delivered in the client's own Cloudflare and GitHub accounts. Live in 7 days or it's free.
- AI Powered CRM: a custom-coded CRM built from scratch around how a roofing company already works, deployed to the client's own Cloudflare account, delivered in 10 days. One-time build, $1,500 to $4,000 typical range, no subscription.
- AI Powered Automations: instant text-back on new leads, smart routing to the right crew and automatic follow-up on old quotes. One-time build, $1,200 to $3,500 typical range, plus pass-through messaging costs, no subscription.

## Websites offer
- Launch: $1,000 one-time. Custom 5-page site, local SEO and AI-search setup, free hosting for life, SSL and security. Live in 7 days or it's free. Includes free domain setup, a Google Business Profile audit and a launch-week review-request system. Optional: +$29/month for 3 small edits.
- Growth: $1,000 setup. Adds 6 SEO blog posts a month, AI search optimization, Google Business Profile optimization, unlimited small edits (48-hour turnaround) and a monthly performance report. Optional: +$349/month.
- Preview first, pay later: no payment until the homepage preview is approved. Clients keep their site, domain and content.

## Ownership philosophy
Every Adaptify service is built once and deployed into infrastructure the client owns outright (their own Cloudflare account), not a tool they rent from Adaptify. The goal of every service is the same: bring the roofing company more customers and make running it easier.
